domains.name: Voice Models
domains.description: End-to-end voice AI solutions for speech understanding, synthesis, and real-time audio intelligence.

products.name: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
products.tagline: Turn spoken words into accurate text at scale
products.description: Our enterprise-grade ASR engine converts audio to text in real-time with industry-leading accuracy. Built for noisy environments, multiple accents, and domain-specific vocabulary including medical, legal, and technical terminology.
key_features: Support for 30+ languages and regional accents
use_cases: Call center transcription and quality assurance

products.name: Real-Time Voice Streaming
products.tagline: Ultra-low latency audio streaming for live voice applications
products.description: A high-performance voice streaming infrastructure that enables real-time bidirectional audio pipelines. Purpose-built for applications where latency is critical — live captioning, voice bots, real-time translation, and interactive voice response systems.
key_features: Adaptive bitrate and packet loss recovery
Auto-scaling to millions of concurrent streams
use_cases: Live voice assistants and conversational AI

products.name: Multilingual Voice Translation
products.tagline: Break language barriers with real-time spoken language translation
products.description: Seamlessly translate spoken language in real-time across 50+ language pairs. Combines our ASR engine with neural machine translation and TTS to deliver natural-sounding translated speech, preserving speaker tone and intent.

products.name: Emotion Detection
products.tagline: Understand how people truly feel through their voice
products.description: Our voice emotion detection model analyzes speech in real-time to identify emotional states including frustration, satisfaction, urgency, confusion, and joy. Goes beyond sentiment — delivers granular emotion scores for each utterance, enabling proactive intervention and deep customer insight.
use_cases: Contact center agent performance and coaching
Churn prediction based on frustration signals
Sales call analysis and deal health

products.name: Speaker Diarization
products.tagline: Know who said what, and when
products.description: Automatically separate and identify individual speakers in multi-party audio recordings. Our diarization engine accurately timestamps and labels each speaker's turns, enabling structured transcription of meetings, interviews, call recordings, and legal proceedings.
key_features: Combined with ASR for full speaker-attributed transcripts
Export to structured formats (JSON, SRT, DOCX)
use_cases: Automated meeting minutes with speaker attribution
Legal deposition and court recording transcription

products.name: Text-to-Speech (TTS)
products.tagline: Human-quality voice synthesis for any application
products.description: Generate natural, expressive speech from text using our neural TTS engine. Offers a library of 100+ voices across 30 languages, with custom voice cloning capabilities. Build voice interfaces, automate narration, or create branded voice identities.
key_features: SSML support for pronunciation and prosody control

products.name: Voice Biometrics & Authentication
products.tagline: Verify identity with the power of voice
products.description: Authenticate users and detect fraud using voice as a biometric. Our passive voice biometrics engine verifies identity in the background during natural conversation — no PINs, no passwords. Includes active challenge-response authentication and deepfake voice fraud detection.
key_features: Passive authentication during natural speech (10-15 seconds)
use_cases: Banking and financial services identity verification

domains.name: AI Agents

products.name: Conversational AI Agent

products.description: Deploy LLM-powered conversational agents that understand intent, manage multi-turn dialogue, and complete complex tasks autonomously. Our agents integrate with your existing tools, CRMs, and databases — handling customer queries, scheduling, support tickets, and more without human intervention.
key_features: Handoff to human agents with full context

products.name: Workflow Automation Agent
products.tagline: AI agents that execute multi-step business workflows autonomously
products.description: Intelligent agents that plan, execute, and adapt multi-step workflows without human intervention. Unlike rigid RPA tools, our agents reason about tasks, handle exceptions, and use APIs, documents, and web data to complete complex business processes end-to-end.
key_features: Audit trail for all agent actions
Integration with 100+ business apps via connectors
use_cases: Lead research and CRM data enrichment
Report generation from multiple data sources

products.name: AI Data Analyst Agent
products.tagline: Ask questions about your data in plain English — get instant insights
products.description: An autonomous data analyst agent that connects to your databases, warehouses, and dashboards. Business users can ask natural language questions and get accurate charts, reports, and recommendations — no SQL or data science knowledge needed.
key_features: Natural language to SQL query generation
Connects to PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift
Scheduled report narratives in plain English
use_cases: Customer churn prediction and root cause

products.name: AI Sales Development Agent (SDR)
products.tagline: Automate prospecting, outreach, and qualification at scale
products.description: A fully autonomous AI sales agent that researches prospects, crafts personalized outreach, follows up intelligently, and qualifies leads — handing only sales-ready conversations to your human team. Operates 24/7 across email, LinkedIn, and phone.
key_features: Intelligent follow-up sequences with timing optimization
CRM sync and pipeline update automation
A/B testing of messaging and sequences
products.pricing_model: Per seat or per qualified lead

products.name: Document Intelligence Agent
products.tagline: Extract, understand, and act on information locked in documents
products.description: An AI agent that reads, understands, and processes unstructured documents — contracts, invoices, reports, medical records, and more. Extract structured data, answer questions about documents, compare versions, flag risks, and trigger downstream workflows automatically.
key_features: Supports PDF, Word, Excel, images, emails
products.pricing_model: Per document or monthly volume plan
